pr_title: [Doc][Misc] Add Ascend950DT support documentation for DeepSeek-V3.1
source_quote: The image tag contains a `#TODO` placeholder and uses incorrect template syntax `|vllm_ascend_version|`. It should use the standard Jinja template syntax `{{ vllm_ascend_version }}` used elsewhere in this file and remove the `#TODO` comment.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha a48ef44 体现修改

rule.description: 部署文档中的 docker 镜像标签、版本号等引用不得残留 `#TODO` 等占位符；模板变量必须使用项目统一的 Jinja 语法 `{{ var }}`，不得使用 `|var|` 等非标准写法。
checkpoints: 检查文档中是否存在 `#TODO`、`#FIXME`、`XXX` 等占位符
检查模板变量是否使用统一的 Jinja 语法 `{{ var }}`（而非 `|var|`、`<var>`、`$var` 等）
检查同一文档中相同变量的写法是否一致（与文档其他位置对照）

antipattern.code:
## Launch the container

Before starting, ensure that the Ascend NPU driver and firmware are properly
installed on your host machine. You can verify the NPU status by running:

```bash
npu-smi info
```

Set the environment variables and pull the Docker image:

```bash
# Set the vLLM Ascend version
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:{{vllm_ascend_version}}-#TODO

# Pull the image
docker pull ${IMAGE}
```
